description: This file defines an abstract base class for testing ReminderTable implementations within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for setting up, tearing down, and testing CRUD operations on reminder entries, including parallel upserts and range queries.

classes.name: ReminderTableTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing various implementations of IReminderTable, providing setup, teardown, and testing utilities.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the reminder table after tests.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Abstract method to create a concrete IReminderTable instance.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve database connection string.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Provides the ADO.NET invariant, default null.

methods.name: RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Performs concurrent upsert operations on reminder entries to test concurrency handling.

methods.name: ReminderSimple
methods.description: Tests insertion, retrieval, and deletion of a single reminder entry.

methods.name: RemindersRange
methods.description: Performs batch updates and range queries to validate large-scale operations.

methods.name: TestRemindersHashInterval
methods.description: Validates the correctness of reading reminder entries within specific hash intervals.

methods.name: CreateReminder
methods.description: Creates a sample ReminderEntry with specified GrainId and reminder name.

methods.name: MakeTestGrainReference
methods.description: Generates a test GrainId for use in reminders.
